title: Fields that respond
summary: Clear buttons and show-password buttons work on every click, with a little bounce.

changes.text: The clear (×) button in search boxes now always clears them. Clicks on its upper half were sometimes lost.
The show/hide password and API key buttons now work on every click.
All text fields share one look and behaviour: search boxes in the material picker and scan review can be cleared too, and the feedback form's name field has a clear button.
Fields give a small squash when you clear them or show/hide a password, and dropdowns do the same when their value changes.

Category and rarity filters are now sliding tab bars, with each count in a small badge. Rarity tabs keep their star colours, and each category has its own colour. The filter card gives a small squash when you switch category.
